answer: Mechanism: burn-to-register. Every identity must send 100 tokens to a verifiable unspendable burn address before it can vote or grade. Attacker cost: a farm of 1,000 clones burns 100,000 tokens and loses all when an audit flags the hollow unspendable outputs, the canyon between 1,000 identities and their voting weight, and no oasis of recoverable funds. Honesty stays cheaper.
